title: Multi-Head Attention
hint: Use nn.Linear for Q/K/V/O projections. d_k = d_model // num_heads. Reshape to (B, heads, S, d_k), SDPA per head, concat, output projection.

description.text: Implement multi-head self-attention as an nn.Module: project to Q, K, V, split into multiple heads, apply scaled dot-product attention per head, concatenate, and apply an output projection.

constraints: Use PyTorch only unless task says otherwise.
